discovery_notes: BoxLunch 2019 sweep via search snippets (29 queries), excluding pins already keyed in 208_b008. Mostly Disney Pins Blog posts plus BoxLunch listings; Princess Bows members from Disney Pin Forum. NBC members matched from an undated BoxLunch listing by name. Maker slug 'boxlunch' used when snippet gave no maker. Keys aligned with concurrent Loungefly packet 219 where the same release appears, so claims corroborate.
